title: hey-claude response widget
description: The widget contract (ROADMAP M5). An answer may end with one line `WIDGET {json}` matching this envelope (it is never read aloud), or a tool result can produce a widget by itself (a manifest's `triggers`). Widgets are plug-ins: each is a folder widgets/<id>/ with widget.json (see x-manifest) and Widget.qml. heyclaude/widgets.py loads them, validates `data` against the widget's own schema, and builds the prompt both answering tiers get. An unknown widget, or data that doesn't validate, falls back to `text` (or nothing).

widget.description: a widget id: a folder under widgets/

text.description: fallback line if the widget can't be shown

ttl_s.description: how long it stays after the answer (default: the widget's ttl_s, else 12)

api.description: widget API major.minor this widget was written for (1.0)

description.description: one line for the model: when to use it

title.description: the card header; {field} placeholders read data fields

glyph.description: a Glyph.qml name for the header (sun, calendar, timer...)

size.description: the panel size it wants; the island grows to it (at most 460 x 280)

private.description: personal content (messages): fades 4 s after the island rests

triggers.description: tools whose result becomes this widget, shown without the model writing it. tools: full names (mcp__weather__get_weather) or the tool's own name (telegram_list_dialogs, on whatever server). data: "result" (the result JSON is the data) or an adapter in heyclaude/widgets.py ADAPTERS (reads JSON or the tool's markdown)

schema.description: JSON Schema of `data` (the subset widgets.validate understands)

example.description: sample data: the prompt shows it, and tests render it

x-qml: Widget.qml gets `data_` (the data) and `wid`; it has `implicitHeight`, `minWidth`, `holds` (keep the card while true) and `signal action(string name, var payload)`. It may import "../../ui/island" for Glyph, Pill, ServiceIcon, Tick. Draw with Qt Quick items, Shapes or ShaderEffect (GPU), not Canvas.
